voice.text: You tap your phone. Here is what happens next. One: your phone sends a token, never your real card number. Two: the terminal reads it and builds the payment request. Three: the shop's bank, the acquirer, passes it on. Four: the card network routes it to your bank. Five: your bank checks funds and limits, then decides. Six: approved, and the answer runs back the same way. Money settles later.
